title: Florida's DeSantis unveils a voting map that could add to Trump's GOP redistricting
summary: Florida's governor has called lawmakers to meet starting Tuesday. They'll consider a fast-track redistricting that could flip some House seats held by Democrats to Republicans.
contentText:
Florida's governor has called lawmakers to meet starting Tuesday. They'll consider a fast-track redistricting that could flip some House seats held by Democrats to Republicans.

(Image credit: Julia Demaree Nikhinson)
